entries.en: Prendergast unfolded the map on the platform and immediately lost his place in the book.
entries.zh: 普伦德加斯特在站台上展开地图，立刻就忘了书读到哪里了。

entries.en: Ms Northcliffe saved the torn envelope because she liked the little drawing on it.
entries.zh: 诺斯克利夫女士留着那个破信封，因为她喜欢上面的小画。

entries.meaningZh: 蒙哥马利郡〔威尔士旧郡名〕
entries.en: The faded map of Montgomeryshire had been folded along the same lines for years.
entries.zh: 那张褪色的蒙哥马利郡地图，多年来一直沿着同样的折痕折叠。

entries.meaningZh: 利特尔顿〔新西兰港口城镇名〕
entries.en: I left my gloves in the room we rented in Lyttelton.
entries.zh: 我把手套落在了我们在利特尔顿租的房间里。

entries.en: The shepherd brought the missing hamel back before nightfall.
entries.zh: 牧羊人在天黑前把那只走失的阉羊带了回来。

entries.en: Cottrell was halfway through his story when the dog stole a sandwich from his plate.
entries.zh: 科特雷尔的故事讲到一半，狗从他的盘子里偷走了一块三明治。

entries.en: Burdon moved his chair into the shade without taking his eyes off the chessboard.
entries.zh: 伯登把椅子移到阴凉处，眼睛却始终没有离开棋盘。

entries.en: Ashburton found the lost earring in the pocket of a coat she rarely wore.
entries.zh: 阿什伯顿在一件很少穿的外套口袋里找到了那只丢失的耳环。

entries.en: Weatherill knew the house was occupied because a violin lay on the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 韦瑟里尔看见厨房桌上放着一把小提琴，知道屋里有人住。

entries.en: Porchester spent the entire journey trying to remember where he had seen that face before.
entries.zh: 整个旅途中，波切斯特都在努力回想自己以前在哪里见过那张面孔。

entries.en: Mackey held the torch while I searched beneath the seats for the missing key.
entries.zh: 我在座椅下面找那把丢失的钥匙时，麦基帮忙举着手电筒。

entries.en: Lucio carried the flowers upstairs, leaving a trail of water on the carpet.
entries.zh: 卢西奥把花拿上楼，在地毯上留下了一路水迹。

entries.en: Jerzy could hear the bell but could not tell which direction it came from.
entries.zh: 耶日听得见钟声，却辨不出声音是从哪个方向传来的。

entries.en: Gowrie removed the price tag before handing the little wooden horse to the child.
entries.zh: 高里先取下价签，才把那匹小木马交给孩子。

entries.en: Boland liked the painting until he noticed that the clock in it had no hands.
entries.zh: 博兰原本很喜欢那幅画，直到他注意到画里的钟没有指针。

entries.meaningZh: 巴伐利亚州〔Bayern为德语州名〕
entries.en: The postcards from Bayern arrived long after we had returned home.
entries.zh: 我们回家很久以后，从巴伐利亚州寄出的明信片才送到。

entries.meaningZh: 皮布尔斯郡〔苏格兰旧郡名〕
entries.en: The archivist spread an old map of Tweeddale across the reading table.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把一张皮布尔斯郡的旧地图摊在阅览桌上。

entries.en: Murrell stopped winding the clock when he heard footsteps on the stairs.
entries.zh: 默雷尔听到楼梯上的脚步声，便停下了给钟上发条的动作。

entries.en: The editor cropped the photograph of Medvedev to leave room for the headline.
entries.zh: 编辑裁剪了梅德韦杰夫的照片，给标题留出空间。

entries.en: Ingrams discovered that he had packed two left shoes for the weekend.
entries.zh: 英格拉姆发现，自己为周末出行装进包里的两只鞋都是左脚鞋。

entries.meaningZh: 亨廷登郡〔英格兰旧郡名〕
entries.en: She found her village on the old map of Huntingdonshire before searching for the river.
entries.zh: 她先在那张亨廷登郡旧地图上找到自己的村庄，再寻找那条河。

entries.en: Hamid turned down the radio so that we could hear the rain on the roof.
entries.zh: 哈米德把收音机的声音调低，好让我们听见雨打屋顶的声音。

entries.en: Curwen asked for a second look at the photograph before answering the question.
entries.zh: 柯温请求再看一眼那张照片，然后才回答问题。

entries.meaningZh: 交叉路口〔英国用语，多见于地名〕
entries.en: They paused at the carfax, unsure which of the four roads led to the mill.
entries.zh: 他们在交叉路口停下来，不确定四条路中哪条通往磨坊。

entries.en: Cardwell left a cup beneath the leak and went to find a larger bowl.
entries.zh: 卡德韦尔在漏水处下面放了一个杯子，随后去找更大的碗。

entries.en: Mr Bacall kept the broken watch because it reminded him of his first journey abroad.
entries.zh: 巴考尔先生留着那块坏表，因为它让他想起第一次出国的旅程。

entries.en: The parcel we sent to Welland came back with the address almost washed away.
entries.zh: 我们寄往韦兰的包裹退了回来，上面的地址几乎被水冲得看不清了。

entries.meaningZh: 越共成员〔西方报刊用语〕
entries.en: In the novel, a Vietcong asks the farmer whether anyone has seen his younger brother.
entries.zh: 在那部小说里，一名越共成员问农民是否有人见过他的弟弟。

entries.meaningZh: 猛打〔英国俚语；tonk的第三人称单数〕
entries.en: In our comic, the giant tonks the door until the hinges shake.
entries.zh: 在我们的漫画里，巨人猛打那扇门，打得铰链直晃。

entries.en: We noticed the missing bag only after we had left Runnymede.
entries.zh: 我们离开兰尼米德后，才发现少了一个包。

entries.en: Ramsbottom borrowed a pencil and immediately tucked it behind his ear.
entries.zh: 拉姆斯博顿借了一支铅笔，随即把它别在耳朵后面。

entries.en: Hoey washed the paint from his hands before touching the old photograph.
entries.zh: 霍伊先洗掉手上的颜料，才去拿那张旧照片。

entries.meaningZh: 医师〔伊斯兰教国家用语〕
entries.en: In the story, the hakim puts down his book when a visitor enters.
entries.zh: 在那个故事里，一名访客进来时，医师放下了手里的书。

entries.en: Ms Haigh had to remove her hat before she could see the person behind her.
entries.zh: 黑格女士得先摘掉帽子，才看得见身后的人。

entries.en: Farrington tasted the soup, then asked who had already added the salt.
entries.zh: 法林顿尝了尝汤，随后问是谁已经加过盐了。

entries.en: Croce hid the birthday cake in the only cupboard the children could not reach.
entries.zh: 克罗斯把生日蛋糕藏在唯一一个孩子们够不到的橱柜里。

entries.en: Vries realized halfway through the song that he was using the wrong words.
entries.zh: 弗里斯唱到一半，才发现自己用错了歌词。

entries.en: Richman found his old school photograph while looking for a spare button.
entries.zh: 里奇曼找备用纽扣时，发现了自己上学时的一张旧照片。

entries.en: In the old story, Mirza Rahim sends a servant to fetch the missing books.
entries.zh: 在那个老故事里，拉希姆先生（Mirza Rahim）派一名仆人去取回那些丢失的书。

entries.en: Iles kept one hand on the gate while he searched his pockets for the key.
entries.zh: 艾尔斯一只手扶着大门，一边在口袋里找钥匙。

entries.en: Cornforth put the unfinished drawing away when the children asked him to join their game.
entries.zh: 孩子们请康福思一起玩时，他收起了那幅尚未完成的画。

entries.en: Chapelle knew the parcel was fragile because he could hear glass moving inside.
entries.zh: 夏佩尔听见包裹里面有玻璃碰动的声音，知道里面的东西易碎。

entries.en: Appleyard forgot the words of the toast, but the guests applauded anyway.
entries.zh: 阿普尔亚德忘了祝酒词，客人们却照样鼓了掌。

entries.en: Reinhard found the umbrella exactly where he had left it the previous evening.
entries.zh: 莱因哈德在自己前一天晚上放伞的原处找到了它。

entries.en: Piercy could read the letter only after someone opened the curtains.
entries.zh: 有人拉开窗帘后，皮尔西才看得清那封信。

entries.en: Coulthard offered to carry the empty basket while we gathered the fallen apples.
entries.zh: 我们捡落在地上的苹果时，库尔撒德提出帮忙拿空篮子。

entries.en: Clemente listened twice before recognizing the voice on the old recording.
entries.zh: 克莱门特听了两遍，才认出那段旧录音里的声音。

entries.en: The archivist placed the letter from BASF beside the earlier correspondence.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把巴斯夫公司的来信放在较早的往来信件旁边。

entries.en: Simonds rescued the invitation from the pile of papers about to be recycled.
entries.zh: 西蒙兹从那堆即将回收的纸里找出了请柬，把它留了下来。

entries.en: Popham thought the room was empty until the chair nearest the window began to move.
entries.zh: 波帕姆原以为房间里没人，直到靠窗最近的椅子开始动起来。

entries.en: Ortiz put down his coffee before attempting the knot for a second time.
entries.zh: 奥尔蒂斯放下咖啡，第二次试着打那个结。

entries.en: Mulcahy left the last biscuit for the guest who had not yet arrived.
entries.zh: 马尔卡希把最后一块饼干留给那位还没到的客人。

entries.en: Manuela could not find her place in the music after the interruption.
entries.zh: 受到打断之后，曼努埃拉在乐谱上找不到自己刚才演奏的位置了。

entries.en: The pressure rose by three torr while she was away from the bench.
entries.zh: 她离开实验台期间，压力上升了三托。

entries.en: The room we rented in Lugano had a desk just large enough for my sketchbook.
entries.zh: 我们在卢加诺租的房间里有一张桌子，刚好够放我的速写本。

entries.en: Daniele tried to follow the recipe but could not read the final handwritten line.
entries.zh: 达妮埃莱想照着食谱做，却看不清最后那行手写的文字。

entries.en: The costume designer sorted the linen biggins by size before the children arrived.
entries.zh: 孩子们到来之前，服装设计师把那些亚麻帽子按大小分好了。

entries.en: Liddle could see the sea from his chair, but not the boat we were watching.
entries.zh: 利德尔坐在椅子上看得见海，却看不见我们正在看的那条船。

entries.en: Sonja took the cake out of the box without disturbing the little paper flowers.
entries.zh: 索尼娅把蛋糕从盒子里取了出来，没有碰乱那些小纸花。

entries.en: Lazenby was about to leave when he noticed the second envelope beneath his coat.
entries.zh: 拉曾比正要走，忽然注意到自己外套下面还有第二个信封。

entries.en: Hartwell washed the cups while the rest of us argued about the answer.
entries.zh: 我们其他人争论答案时，哈特韦尔在洗杯子。

entries.en: Kells carefully removed the price label from the back of the frame.
entries.zh: 凯尔斯小心地取下了画框背面的价签。

entries.en: The historian compared two archived letters from Aerospatiale before returning them to the folder.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了法国宇航公司的两封存档信件，随后把它们放回文件夹。

entries.en: Newcombe brought a book to the picnic but never opened it.
entries.zh: 纽科姆带了一本书去野餐，却始终没有翻开。

entries.en: Marcello knew the tune, though he could not remember who had taught it to him.
entries.zh: 马尔塞洛记得曲调，却想不起是谁教他的。

entries.en: Grogan found a quiet seat, only to discover that he had left his glasses at home.
entries.zh: 格罗根找到了一个安静的座位，却发现自己把眼镜落在了家里。

entries.en: Frieda drew the curtains apart and found the garden covered in snow.
entries.zh: 弗里达拉开窗帘，看见花园里覆盖着雪。

entries.en: Bradwell carried the empty cases upstairs while I waited for the lift.
entries.zh: 我等电梯时，布拉德韦尔把那些空箱子搬上了楼。

entries.meaningZh: 奥尔德尼乳牛〔旧品种名〕
entries.en: In the old farming novel, an Alderney blocks the narrow gate until the boy arrives.
entries.zh: 在那部旧时的农场题材小说里，一头奥尔德尼乳牛一直堵着窄门，直到男孩到来。

entries.en: The translator compared two photographs of the same Bactrian inscription.
entries.zh: 译者比较了同一处大夏铭文的两张照片。

entries.en: Gosse searched the garden for the ball until he noticed it beneath his own chair.
entries.zh: 戈斯在花园里找球，后来才注意到球就在自己的椅子下面。

entries.en: Ms Sharma placed a clean cloth beneath the vase before filling it with water.
entries.zh: 沙玛女士先在花瓶下面垫了一块干净的布，才往里面加水。

entries.en: A Yucatecan musician lent us a recording she had made with her friends.
entries.zh: 一位尤卡坦音乐家借给我们一份她和朋友们一起录制的录音。

entries.en: Mottram held the page flat while I copied the address into my notebook.
entries.zh: 我把地址抄进笔记本时，莫特拉姆帮忙按平那一页。

entries.en: The Salesian stayed behind after the concert to help stack the chairs.
entries.zh: 音乐会结束后，那位慈幼会成员留了下来，帮忙把椅子摞好。

entries.en: The cartoon gives the tiny gardener Atlantean strength when he lifts the gate.
entries.zh: 在那部动画片里，个头很小的园丁抬起大门时，展现出力大无双的本领。

entries.en: Saskia turned the sketch upside down to see why the proportions looked wrong.
entries.zh: 萨斯基亚把素描倒过来看，想弄清比例为什么显得不对。

entries.en: Zbigniew remembered the umbrella only when the first drops of rain reached his face.
entries.zh: 最初几滴雨落到脸上时，兹比格纽才想起雨伞。

entries.en: Tulloch counted the cups again after two more guests arrived without warning.
entries.zh: 又有两位客人突然到来，塔洛克重新数了一遍杯子。

entries.en: Lyndhurst covered the piano before opening the windows to let out the smell of paint.
entries.zh: 林德赫斯特先盖好钢琴，才打开窗户散去油漆味。

entries.en: Kubla borrowed my scarf and returned it neatly folded in a paper bag.
entries.zh: 库布拉借了我的围巾，还回来时把它叠得整整齐齐，放在一个纸袋里。

entries.en: Pettigrew wanted the window open, but the loose curtain kept brushing his face.
entries.zh: 佩蒂格鲁想开着窗，可松散的窗帘不断拂到他脸上。

entries.en: Annes set the cake on the wrong table and had to carry it across the room again.
entries.zh: 安妮斯把蛋糕放错了桌子，只好再次端着它穿过房间。

entries.en: Shaffer found the missing chess piece inside the shoe he had left by the door.
entries.zh: 谢弗在自己放在门边的鞋子里找到了那枚丢失的棋子。

entries.en: Berkley asked us to wait until the kettle had stopped whistling.
entries.zh: 伯克利请我们等到水壶不再鸣响。

entries.en: Giancarlo carefully lifted the sleeping cat before sitting down in the armchair.
entries.zh: 詹卡洛小心地抱起那只睡着的猫，才在扶手椅上坐下。

entries.en: We left the broken suitcase in Bergamo and borrowed a bag for the journey home.
entries.zh: 我们把坏行李箱留在贝加莫，借了一个包供返程使用。

entries.en: Sturrock could smell fresh bread but could not find the bakery entrance.
entries.zh: 斯特罗克闻到了新鲜面包的香味，却找不到面包店的入口。

entries.en: Stephane folded the letter twice before realizing that he had forgotten to sign it.
entries.zh: 史蒂芬把信折了两次，才发现自己忘了签名。

entries.en: Rocca closed the sketchbook when the wind began to scatter his pencils.
entries.zh: 风开始把铅笔吹得四散时，罗卡合上了速写本。

entries.en: Rhona moved the lamp so that the child could see the tiny print.
entries.zh: 罗娜挪了挪灯，好让孩子看清那些小字。

entries.en: Pauls arrived carrying a basket of apples and an invitation addressed to someone else.
entries.zh: 保尔斯到来时，提着一篮苹果，还带着一张写给别人的请柬。

entries.en: Iwan kept the last page covered while we tried to guess the answer.
entries.zh: 我们试着猜答案时，伊万一直盖着最后一页。

entries.en: Girouard left the bread to cool and went outside to call the children.
entries.zh: 吉鲁阿尔把面包放着晾凉，随后到外面叫孩子们。

entries.en: Ciudad hesitated before choosing the smallest box on the table.
entries.zh: 休达犹豫了一下，才选了桌上最小的盒子。

entries.en: Bundy carried the flowers home without noticing that one of his gloves was missing.
entries.zh: 邦迪带着花回家，没有注意到自己少了一只手套。

entries.en: The lecturer compared two Joycean passages that had puzzled the class.
entries.zh: 讲师比较了两段让全班感到困惑的乔伊斯作品中的文字。

entries.en: Her letters from Tinseltown always arrived with drawings in the margins.
entries.zh: 她从浮华城寄来的信，页边总画着些画。

entries.en: Rattray picked up the wrong suitcase and noticed only when the handle broke.
entries.zh: 拉特雷拿错了行李箱，直到把手断了才发现。

entries.en: The illustrator redrew the pilar structures after examining the enlarged photograph.
entries.zh: 插画师查看放大的照片后，重新画了那些毛发结构。

entries.en: Marisa removed the wet leaves from the bench before inviting us to sit down.
entries.zh: 玛丽莎先清掉长椅上的湿叶子，才请我们坐下。

entries.en: In the satire, a wealthy Babbitt fears being seen in the unfashionable café.
entries.zh: 在那部讽刺作品里，一个富有的巴比特式人物害怕被人看见自己待在那家不时髦的咖啡馆里。

entries.en: Kingsbury asked for the recipe after discovering that the cake contained no chocolate.
entries.zh: 金斯伯里发现蛋糕里没有巧克力后，便索要了食谱。

entries.en: The researcher compared two books about Irangate and kept notes on their differences.
entries.zh: 那位研究者比较了两本关于伊朗门事件的书，并记下了它们的不同之处。

entries.en: Hendrick drew a line beneath the address so that nobody would mistake it for the signature.
entries.zh: 亨德里克在地址下面画了一条线，免得有人把它当成签名。

entries.en: The gloves I bought in Haarlem were still wrapped in their original paper.
entries.zh: 我在哈勒姆买的那双手套，还包在原来的包装纸里。

entries.en: Franke put the empty bowl beside the cake, hoping someone would notice.
entries.zh: 弗兰克把空碗放到蛋糕旁边，希望有人注意到。

entries.en: Errington enjoyed the walk until he discovered a hole in one of his boots.
entries.zh: 埃林顿原本散步散得很开心，后来却发现一只靴子上破了个洞。

entries.meaningZh: 德国足球甲级联赛〔联赛名〕
entries.en: They listened to a recording of an old Bundesliga match while sorting the photographs.
entries.zh: 他们一边整理照片，一边听一场早年德甲比赛的录音。

entries.en: Bagnall left a space in the album for the photograph that had not yet arrived.
entries.zh: 巴格诺尔在相册里留了一个位置，放那张还没送到的照片。

entries.en: The artist painted Absalom twice before deciding which portrait to include in the exhibition.
entries.zh: 画家画了两幅押沙龙的肖像，才决定选哪幅参展。

entries.en: The programme paired a Caledonian folk song with a reading from the singer's diary.
entries.zh: 节目把一首苏格兰民歌与歌手日记的朗读编排在一起。

entries.en: Soleil stopped reading when she realized that the child beside her had fallen asleep.
entries.zh: 苏蕾发现身旁的孩子睡着了，便停止了阅读。

entries.en: Sandon forgot the house number but recognized the cracked blue flowerpot by the door.
entries.zh: 桑登忘了门牌号，却认出了门边那个裂开的蓝色花盆。

entries.en: She phoned Ramada to ask whether anyone had found the umbrella she left behind.
entries.zh: 她打电话给华美达，询问是否有人找到了她落下的雨伞。

entries.en: Quinlan found a second photograph tucked behind the first one in the frame.
entries.zh: 昆兰发现，画框里的第一张照片后面还塞着第二张照片。

entries.en: Pomeroy could hear laughter upstairs but stayed at the table to finish his letter.
entries.zh: 波默罗伊听见楼上有笑声，但仍留在桌前，想把信写完。

entries.en: Perera removed the label from the jar before using it as a vase.
entries.zh: 佩雷拉先揭掉罐子上的标签，才把它当作花瓶使用。

entries.en: Merrell had brought enough chairs, but two of them would not unfold.
entries.zh: 梅里尔带了足够的椅子，可其中两把怎么也展不开。

entries.en: Lieberman held the door open while the children carried their cardboard castle inside.
entries.zh: 孩子们把纸板城堡搬进屋时，利伯曼帮忙扶着门。

entries.en: Godden recognized the tune before he remembered where he had first heard it.
entries.zh: 戈登先认出了曲调，随后才想起自己第一次听到它是在哪里。

entries.meaningZh: 达姆施塔特〔德国城市名〕
entries.en: She found the receipt from Darmstadt in a book she had not opened for years.
entries.zh: 她在一本多年没翻过的书里，发现了那张来自达姆施塔特的收据。

entries.en: In the old tale, a fallen tree hides the entrance to the cundy.
entries.zh: 在那个老故事里，一棵倒下的树遮住了小通道的入口。

entries.meaningZh: 伯爵〔西班牙外来称谓；旧故事语境〕
entries.en: In the old novel, the Conde refuses the larger room and asks to sleep near the garden.
entries.zh: 在那部旧小说里，那位伯爵拒绝了较大的房间，要求住在靠近花园的地方。

entries.en: Colston remembered the birthday but had put the present in an unmarked box.
entries.zh: 科尔斯顿记得生日，却把礼物装进了一个没有标记的盒子里。

entries.en: Bowness reached for the envelope, then realized that his hands were covered in flour.
entries.zh: 鲍内斯伸手去拿信封，才发现自己手上沾满了面粉。

entries.en: We missed the bus in Bahia and spent the afternoon drawing the empty station.
entries.zh: 我们在巴伊亚没赶上公共汽车，便花了一下午画那座空荡荡的车站。

entries.en: Bagley tried the key in three doors before finding the one it opened.
entries.zh: 巴格利用那把钥匙试了三扇门，才找到能打开的那扇。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔贝维尔〔法国城市名〕
entries.en: We returned to Albertville to collect the suitcase we had left at our host's house.
entries.zh: 我们返回阿尔贝维尔，去取落在接待我们的人家里的行李箱。

entries.en: The zoologist compared two archived drawings of Toxoplasma before revising the diagram.
entries.zh: 那位动物学家在修改示意图之前，比较了两幅存档的弓形体属生物图。

entries.en: Varney had never seen the old photograph and wanted to know who had taken it.
entries.zh: 瓦尼以前从未见过那张旧照片，想知道是谁拍的。

entries.en: Sidmouth put down the violin when he noticed that the audience had begun to sing.
entries.zh: 西德茅斯发现听众们开始唱起来，便放下了小提琴。

entries.en: Sandro dried the bench with his coat before offering me a place to sit.
entries.zh: 桑德罗用自己的外套擦干长椅，才提出让我坐下。

entries.en: Ruston wanted a photograph of the empty room before the furniture arrived.
entries.zh: 拉斯顿想在家具送到之前，给空房间拍张照片。

entries.en: Longden lifted the lid and discovered that someone had already eaten the last biscuit.
entries.zh: 朗登打开盖子，发现最后一块饼干已经被人吃掉了。

entries.en: Leitch put the map away when he recognized the tree beside the path.
entries.zh: 利奇认出了路边那棵树，便收起了地图。

entries.en: Lawlor rescued the letter before the rain could wash away the handwritten address.
entries.zh: 劳勒赶在雨水冲掉手写地址之前，把那封信收了起来。

entries.en: Kwame knew the song, but the children insisted on teaching him their version.
entries.zh: 夸梅会唱那首歌，可孩子们坚持要教他他们的版本。

entries.en: Kitzinger folded the newspaper around the broken frame before putting it in the bag.
entries.zh: 基青格先用报纸包住破画框，才把它放进包里。

entries.en: Istvan recognized the laugh before he saw who was standing behind the curtain.
entries.zh: 伊斯特万先听出了那人的笑声，随后才看见是谁站在窗帘后面。

entries.en: Hartington waited for the ink to dry before closing the notebook.
entries.zh: 哈廷顿等墨水干了，才合上笔记本。

entries.en: Gilliam brought the wrong music but managed to borrow a copy before the rehearsal began.
entries.zh: 吉列姆带错了乐谱，但在排练开始前设法借到了一份。

entries.en: Cragg could not find the cup he had just placed behind the curtain.
entries.zh: 克拉格找不到自己刚刚放在窗帘后面的杯子了。

entries.en: Collis moved his chair closer to the fire without interrupting the story.
entries.zh: 科里斯把椅子挪得更靠近炉火，没有打断故事。

entries.en: Christa brushed the crumbs from the table before laying out the photographs.
entries.zh: 克丽斯塔先刷掉桌上的碎屑，才把照片摆开。

entries.meaningZh: 船内走廊上的特等舱位
entries.en: In the sea story, she leaves her luggage in the Bibby and returns to the deck.
entries.zh: 在那个航海故事里，她把行李留在走廊上的特等舱里，又回到甲板上。

entries.en: Antoni poured the tea and waited for someone to explain the sudden silence.
entries.zh: 安东尼倒好茶，等着有人解释为什么突然安静下来。

entries.en: She broke an abernethy in half and put one piece beside each cup.
entries.zh: 她把一块硬饼干掰成两半，在每个杯子旁各放了一半。

entries.en: The seminar compared Baconian ideas with a different account of scientific inquiry.
entries.zh: 研讨课把培根的哲学思想与另一种有关科学探究的论述作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 南非山龙眼属〔植物属名〕
entries.en: The botanist reorganized the Protea specimens to leave space for the new collection.
entries.zh: 植物学家重新整理了南非山龙眼属的标本，给新收藏留出空间。

entries.en: Walsham hid the little gift beneath the folded napkins before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人们到来之前，沃尔沙姆把那件小礼物藏在叠好的餐巾下面。

entries.en: Tinsley read the last page twice, unwilling to believe that the story had ended.
entries.zh: 廷斯利把最后一页读了两遍，不愿相信故事已经结束。

entries.en: After Rigoletto, we waited outside while our friend searched for her scarf.
entries.zh: 看完《弄臣》后，我们在外面等朋友找她的围巾。

entries.en: The notebook I used in Morningside still had a pressed flower between its pages.
entries.zh: 我在莫宁赛德用过的那本笔记本，书页间还夹着一朵压干的花。

entries.en: Mehmet turned the frame around to check whether anyone had written a date on the back.
entries.zh: 穆罕默德把画框翻过来，查看是否有人在背面写了日期。

entries.en: Madigan found the missing glove when he shook the leaves out of his coat.
entries.zh: 马迪根抖落外套上的叶子时，找到了那只丢失的手套。

entries.en: She folded the drawing of the Liffey carefully before slipping it into the envelope.
entries.zh: 她小心地折好那幅利菲河的画，随后塞进信封。

entries.en: The historian placed two old maps of Languedoc beside the travel diary.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家把两张郎格多克旧地图放在旅行日记旁边。

entries.en: We sent the blue suitcase back to Koblenz after finding its owner's address.
entries.zh: 找到箱主的地址后，我们把那个蓝色行李箱寄回了科布伦次。

entries.en: They sat beneath the kiri while the artist finished her drawing.
entries.zh: 画家完成画作期间，他们一直坐在泡桐树下。

entries.en: Janette put the wet letter near the window and hoped the ink would remain readable.
entries.zh: 珍妮特把湿信放在窗边，希望墨迹仍能辨认。

entries.en: Impey left his chair to fetch a blanket for the guest nearest the door.
entries.zh: 英庇离开座位，去给坐在离门最近处的客人拿毯子。

entries.en: Fairlie traced the path with a finger before deciding where to start the walk.
entries.zh: 费尔利用手指沿着路线划过，才决定从哪里开始步行。

entries.en: Dawe unfolded the paper and found a small sketch inside the letter.
entries.zh: 道展开纸张，发现信里夹着一幅小素描。

entries.meaningZh: 克里斯蒂娜〔电视剧角色名〕
entries.en: The actress playing Cristina stopped halfway through her first line.
entries.zh: 扮演克里斯蒂娜的女演员，第一句台词说到一半就停了下来。

entries.en: Bude offered to hold the lamp while I searched the floor for the tiny screw.
entries.zh: 我在地上找那颗小螺丝时，布德提出帮忙举着灯。

entries.en: The scarf I left in Berwyn arrived by post with a handwritten note.
entries.zh: 我落在伯温的围巾寄到了，里面还附着一张手写便条。

entries.en: Beeson could not decide which photograph to send, so he enclosed both.
entries.zh: 比森拿不定主意寄哪张照片，于是把两张都放了进去。

entries.en: Artur remembered the tune only after the pianist played the opening bars again.
entries.zh: 钢琴师再次弹出开头几小节之后，阿图尔才想起曲调。

entries.en: She found the receipt from Amritsar tucked inside the cover of her notebook.
entries.zh: 她发现那张来自阿姆利则的收据，塞在笔记本的封皮内侧。

entries.en: The students tried to make their short film more Hitchcockian by delaying the revelation.
entries.zh: 学生们试着推迟揭晓谜底，让自己的短片更具希区柯克风格。

entries.meaningZh: 德系犹太人的〔Ashkenazi的形容词形式〕
entries.en: She chose a book by an Ashkenazic poet for the reading group.
entries.zh: 她为读书小组选了一本德系犹太诗人写的书。

entries.en: Ms Tompkins left the parcel unopened until the child returned from school.
entries.zh: 汤普金斯女士一直没有打开包裹，直到孩子放学回来。

entries.en: Swayze put down his fork when he recognized the voice on the radio.
entries.zh: 斯韦兹认出收音机里的声音，便放下了叉子。

entries.en: Sharkey closed the garden gate quietly so that the sleeping dog would not wake.
entries.zh: 夏基轻轻关上花园大门，免得吵醒那只睡着的狗。
